title: Put your own start in agents/<role>/status.json as "session"
summary: everyone: put your own start in agents/<role>/status.json as "session": { "id" (session_...), "started_at" (UTC), "started_by", "started_by_session", "on_whose_word", "source" }; when you take over a role, move the earlier one into "earlier_sessions" with "ended_at" and "ended_because": the hand-over on your home then says why in your own words.
closes: The one it waits on answers, and the asking agent's status file no longer lists it.
